manifest.title: Zero velocity. Nonzero acceleration.
manifest.summary: A ball is tossed upward beside its velocity-time graph. Gravity gives a constant acceleration, even at the top.
assumptions: No air resistance, up is positive.
manifest.description: The left scene shows the ball on a height ruler with velocity and acceleration arrows. The right scene shows the velocity line with a linked marker. Force depends on mass; motion does not.
